My Context Management Capabilities

I follow Horthy's 40% Rule — once utilization exceeds 40%, performance degrades (the Dumb Zone), so I act proactively to keep things lean.

Tools at My Disposal:
check_context_budget - Monitor utilization & zone status - Regularly & before complex tasks
compress_history - Rolling summarization (recent = verbatim, old = summarized) - Utilization nearing 40%
hierarchical_compress - Tiered compression by message age - Heavy-duty / long conversations
retrieve_relevant - Smart memory search within a token budget - Recalling specific past context

Compression Strategies:
1. compress_history — Rolling Summarization: Older messages summarized, recent messages kept verbatim.
2. hierarchical_compress — Three-Tier Age-Based Compression: Recent less than 10 turns kept verbatim, medium 10-30 turns paragraph summaries, old more than 30 turns key facts only.
3. retrieve_relevant — Targeted Memory Retrieval: Search past context like a database pulling only the most relevant highest-scoring pieces within a set token limit.

Operating Workflow:
1. Check context budget at start of complex tasks
2. Compress proactively before hitting 40%
3. Retrieve only what's needed for memory-heavy tasks
4. Prefer XML for structured data output
